name: @nexus/web-a11y
description: Nexus web/desktop accessibility + LF-005 cross-device continuity proof package (EP-033 M5): renders the REAL @nexus/ui production components through react-dom/server, loads the actual markup in REAL headless Chrome, runs the axe-core WCAG 2.2 AA rule set, and proves the cross-device objective journey (voice start -> web dashboard continue -> mobile approval -> same task graph) against the real @nexus/web and @nexus/desktop components. Browser runtime is real (system Chrome, no emulation); the scan is machine-observed; evidence is current-run bound.
